column1: # Manifest of every third-party source the "Build Custom Monolithic Godot Engine"
# workflow knows about. Tab separated, exactly 6 fields per row.
# Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
#   key    url    ref    role    link    note
#   key   directory name under modules/ (also the git clone target name)
#   ref   git ref to check out; '-' means the repository default branch
#   role  engine  = the Godot source tree that is built (exactly one row)
#         module  = a real SCons Godot module that may be linked into modules/<link>
#         exclude = tracked/known but NOT linked into the build; see note for why
#   link  name of the symlink created in <engine>/modules, '-' when not linked
#   note  provenance: how this row was verified
# No field may be left empty: tab is IFS whitespace, so an empty field would
# collapse and shift every following column.
# verified 2026-10-13 against the upstream default branches:
#   * 14 of the original 19 clone URLs resolved, 5 returned HTTP 404 (see notes)
#   * module registration was verified by the presence of config.py + register_types.cpp/.h
#   * duplicate dependencies were checked against the engine's own modules/ and thirdparty/
#   * this repository tracks 14 gitlinks under modules/ but has NO .gitmodules, so
#     `git submodule update --init` fails; the workflow clones sources explicitly instead.
godot-engine
column6: Fork of godotengine/godot (default branch nvidia-pt-dlss). modules/godot-engine gitlink pins 135dff3887a3d2ccf45cafbd9bdffa7b718e1e76 (= branch HEAD today). The fork has no .gitmodules.

column1: limboai
column6: Verified genuine module: root config.py (can_build/configure/get_doc_classes) + register_types.cpp/.h. The workflow's URL limboai/limboai returns 404.

column1: godot-sqlite
column6: Verified genuine module: root config.py + register_types.cpp/.h + SCsub + bundled thirdparty/sqlite3. README: install as modules/sqlite. The workflow's URL 2shady4you/godot-sqlite returns 404 (that name points at the GDExtension fork 2shady4u/godot-sqlite).

column1: # --- excluded: already shipped by the engine (duplicate dependency) --------
jolt_physics
column6: DUPLICATE. Not an SCons module any more (CMake; README: "a native extension ... maintenance mode"). The engine already ships modules/jolt_physics + thirdparty/jolt_physics.

column1: meshoptimizer
column6: DUPLICATE. The engine already ships modules/meshoptimizer + thirdparty/meshoptimizer.

column1: recastnavigation
column6: DUPLICATE. The engine already ships thirdparty/recastnavigation (used by navigation_3d/navigation_2d).

column1: # --- excluded: no Godot module registration ------------------------------
RTXDI
column6: Plain C++ SDK. No config.py / register_types, so it is not a Godot module.

column1: NRD
column6: Plain C++ SDK. No config.py / register_types, so it is not a Godot module.

column1: steam_audio
column6: Plain C++ audio SDK. No config.py / register_types; it needs a wrapper module that is not present here.

column1: osmnx
column6: Python library. Unrelated to the C++ engine build.

cesium
